title: Good Vibrations | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched in the charming Seagrove community along scenic 30A, Good Vibrations is a stunning modern beach cottage that blends coastal elegance with effortless comfort. Surrounded by the natural beauty of sugar-white sand, rolling dunes, and the peaceful waters of Eastern Lake, this newly built retreat captures the spirit of classic Old Florida while offering refined, contemporary design. Warm wood tones, custom lighting, and expansive open living spaces create an inviting atmosphere, while the chef’s kitchen—featuring a six-burner gas range, Sub-Zero refrigerator, marble countertops, and a spacious island—anchors the home as the perfect gathering place. Thoughtful touches such as a modern fireplace, multiple laundry sets, and a private elevator add convenience to the home’s luxurious style. Outdoor living is just as impressive, with a private resort-style pool and spa, expansive decks, and beautiful Gulf views that set the stage for unforgettable mornings and golden sunset evenings. Multiple king suites and well-designed bunk rooms provide flexible accommodations for families and groups, while inviting lounge areas offer space to relax and reconnect. Six complimentary bikes and a six-seater golf cart make exploring Seagrove and the Timpoochee Trail effortless, with nearby beaches, coastal dune lakes, and charming 30A communities waiting just moments away. With its sophisticated design, exceptional amenities, and prime location, this coastal oasis offers a truly elevated 30A getaway.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
